result.topic_en: Gauss studies the hypergeometric differential equation satisfied by the series P = 1 + x/4 + (1·9)/(4·16)x² + … (the arithmetic-geometric-mean / complete elliptic integral series), its companion solution Q, the Wronskian relation, and the inversion via theta-like series in z = e^{-πQ/P}, deriving differential equations for T = 1/P and U and checking them with power series in z.

methods.what: Hypergeometric-type differential equation for P with change of independent variable
Series solutions P and Q (complete elliptic integral / AGM series in x and 1-x)
Wronskian relation of the two solutions
Theta-series representation of P and x in terms of nome z
Nome defined by ratio of solutions
Differential relation between z and x
Transformed differential equation for P in variable z
Substitution P=1/T giving ODE for T in z
Expression of x via T and U, and coupled ODEs
